name: AnimatedDefaultTextStyle
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in the default text style (TextStyle) of its child over a given duration. Useful for smooth text style transitions without a StatefulWidget.
how_to_use:
AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
  style: _isBold
      ? TextStyle(fontSize: 24, color: Colors.blue, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)
      : TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Colors.black, fontWeight: FontWeight.normal),
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: const Text('Animated Text Style'),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose text style will be animated.

properties.name: style
properties.description: The target text style to animate to.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate the text style changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating the text style changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut

properties.name: textAlign
properties.description: How the text should be aligned horizontally within its bounds.
properties.possible_values: start, end, center, justify, left, right

properties.name: softWrap
properties.description: Whether the text should break at soft line breaks.

properties.name: overflow
properties.description: How visual overflow should be handled.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: The maximum number of lines for the text.
